tceqVsComptrollerEvidence: TCEQ deployment: 2775 polygons (17 TYPE values incl MUD 1888, WCID 250, MMD 197). Comptroller latest-year: 3028 unique entities (MUD 1379, ESD 282, PID 197, 758 non-water types absent from TCEQ layer). Strict name crosswalk matched 131/3028 (4.33%); loose county+type+number ~38.8%. Comptroller-only without TCEQ polygon: ~2897 entities; TCEQ polygons without registry match: ~2646. Tax rates present on 425/3028 Comptroller entities; rateEnrichedCount 0 on Harris/Bastrop dry-runs due to name/county join friction (cnty_cd suffix mapping), not missing registry. Universes overlap but are NOT identical: Comptroller is tabular self-reported superset of types; TCEQ is statewide water-district geometry superset for spatial membership.
reasoning: R1 split rule: MUD is a TCEQ district TYPE attribute on the same polygon source as WCID/MMD/FWSD/SUD — subcategorize via special-district-fact body districtType, not a separate rail. special-district-fact is built (contract 1.19.0, engine PR #301, 2775 tx_special_district polygons loaded, county writer demonstrated on Harris/Bastrop). Retiring the rail would drop accountability for special-district apply (254 cells removed, denominator 3556→3302) without eliminating duplicate work — the duplicate was declaration-vs-reality, not two writers. Comptroller remains optional tax-rate enrichment inside the same cell; 758 non-water Comptroller entities (ESD/PID/hospital) lack TCEQ geometry and cannot justify a separate spatial rail today — phase-4 expansion within special-district-fact when boundary sources verified.

Strict crosswalk 4.33% confirms agencies disagree on naming/universe; does not justify duplicate rail. Subcategorize-in-place fixes 254 misreported no-atom cells without denominator change.

adversarialFindings: OPPOSITE CASE (keep-separate-rail): Comptroller lists 282 ESD + 197 PID + 758 non-water entities with no TCEQ polygon; buyer disclosure for emergency-services and improvement districts is real; tax rates on 425/3028 entities are Comptroller-only value. A separate mud/Comptroller rail could carry registry-only membership with sourceTier downgrade.

REJECTED because: (1) Comptroller has zero geometry — a separate rail cannot produce point-in-polygon membership any more than the TCEQ rail; (2) R1 says split on source+geometry difference — Comptroller differs on ATTRIBUTE (rates, debt), not geometry; (3) special-district-fact already subcategorizes districtType and accepts optional Comptroller enrich; (4) duplicate rail key 'mud' vs atom family 'special-district-fact' was the actual defect — misreporting 254 no-atom cells, not missing coverage class.

RETIRE-MUD-RAIL considered: would fix duplicate naming and drop denominator to 3302. REJECTED: removes manifest column for special-district apply progress; no other rail absorbs the 254 cells; operator ledger would stop tracking special-district coverage entirely.
